summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as NAT egress router for node2/node3 on a private 10.50.50.0/24 network reachable via their second NIC (eth1 on node1, ens7 on node2/node3). Added VyOS source NAT masquerade rule 100 (source 10.50.50.0/24 -> outbound eth0) and committed/saved config. On node2/node3, statically configured ens7 (10.50.50.11/.12) and added a low-metric (50) default route via node1 (10.50.50.254) on ens7, so ordinary process traffic egresses through node1's NAT while their pre-existing management-network route remains as a fallback. Verified NAT translation via conntrack on node1 (src 10.50.50.11/.12 translated to node1's WAN IP 10.100.62.10) and confirmed internet reachability (ping/curl) from both node2 and node3 sourced on ens7. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id baselines on all three nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time) via native `reboot`, confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reconnecting, and verified post-restart that NAT config persisted on node1 (VyOS `show nat` still shows rule 100) and that node2/node3 retained their static IP/route config and successfully reached the internet through node1 again.
actions_performed: Inspected topology and interfaces on node1/node2/node3 (dual-NIC each: management network 10.100.62.0/24, unaddressed private network via eth1/ens7)
Configured node1 eth1 = 10.50.50.254/24 and VyOS NAT source rule 100 (10.50.50.0/24 -> masquerade via eth0), committed and saved
Configured node2 ens7 = 10.50.50.11/24 with persistent /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg and added default route via 10.50.50.254 metric 50
Configured node3 ens7 = 10.50.50.12/24 with persistent /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg and added default route via 10.50.50.254 metric 50
Verified NAT translation via conntrack on node1 and successful ping/curl to the internet from node2 and node3 over ens7
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified NAT config persisted and node2/node3 connectivity restored
Restarted node2 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified static IP/route persisted and internet reachable via node1
Restarted node3 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified static IP/route persisted and internet reachable via node1
